before.stem: ww The renal artery is derived from which of the following blood vessels:
before.explanation: The renal artery arises from the abdominal aorta just inferior to the origin of the superior mesenteric artery just between vertebrae L1 and L2 and posterior to the pancreas. : Vv

after.learningNote: The renal arteries arise from the abdominal aorta, inferior to the superior mesenteric artery.
after.highYieldNote: The renal arteries arise from the abdominal aorta, inferior to the superior mesenteric artery.
after.mnemonic: Renal arteries arise from the aorta.

memoryAid.coreFact: The renal arteries arise from the abdominal aorta, inferior to the superior mesenteric artery.

evidence.externalFinding: NCBI confirms the renal arteries arise from the abdominal aorta.
